meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会像一位资深设计总监，帮你构思独特的视觉风格，包括配色、字体和布局，并写出配套的文案。它会先制定设计方案，自我审查避免模板化，再生成代码。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计或修改网页界面，尤其是强调要避免千篇一律的模板风格时，它会主动接管设计决策。

say.text: 帮我设计一个咖啡品牌的落地页，要独特，不要模板感。
say.note: Claude 会先构思配色、字体和布局方案，然后生成代码。

say.text: 这个页面太普通了，重新设计，加一个让人记住的亮点。
say.note: Claude 会分析现有设计，提出一个独特的签名元素并重构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a design lead, helping you create distinctive visual identities with color, typography, layout, and copy. It plans, self-critiques to avoid defaults, then generates code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design or redesign a web UI, especially when you emphasize avoiding templated looks.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for a coffee brand, make it unique, no templates.
say_en.note: Claude will first propose a color, type, and layout plan, then code.

say_en.text: This page looks generic, redesign it with a memorable signature element.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and introduce a distinctive signature.
